hero.title: Get paid on a schedule you can plan around.
hero.description: Every order's earnings become available 14 days after the customer pays. No waiting on delivery confirmations, and no guessing when money will land.

breakdown.title: See what you earn before you ship
breakdown.description: Each order shows the price, the commission and what reaches you, along with the day it becomes yours to withdraw.
points: 10% commission, only on what you sell
No monthly fee and no listing fee
A release date on every order

bespoke.title: Paid in two parts, on the same schedule
bespoke.description: The customer pays a deposit when they accept your quote and the balance when they approve photos of the finished piece. Each part reaches you 14 days after it's paid.
points: Deposit as soon as your quote is accepted
A cancellation fee paid to you if they cancel after you confirm

withdraw.title: Withdraw whenever you like
withdraw.description: Send your available balance to your verified bank account at any time. Every payout is listed in your history.
points: Paid to your verified business account

closing.title: Get paid. Plan ahead.
closing.description: Join the vendor waitlist and sell with payouts you can count on.
